questions.question: Which option correctly represents Lorentz Force?
questions.answer: F = q v B sin theta
questions.solution: Lorentz Force: Magnetic force on moving charge. The correct relation is F = q v B sin theta.
questions.shortcut: Draw the model first, then apply the formula.
options: F = q v B sin theta
F = q(v x B)
Only the average value is required
It is independent of all variables

questions.question: Which option correctly represents Vector Form of Magnetic Force?
questions.answer: F = q(v x B)
questions.solution: Vector Form of Magnetic Force: Force is perpendicular to velocity and magnetic field. The correct relation is F = q(v x B).
questions.shortcut: Draw the model first, then apply the formula.
options: F = q(v x B)
r = m v/(q B)
Only the average value is required
It is independent of all variables

questions.question: Which option correctly represents Radius in Uniform B?
questions.answer: r = m v/(q B)
questions.solution: Radius in Uniform B: Magnetic force provides centripetal force. The correct relation is r = m v/(q B).
questions.shortcut: Draw the model first, then apply the formula.
options: r = m v/(q B)
T = 2 pi m/(q B)
Only the average value is required
It is independent of all variables

questions.question: Which option correctly represents Time Period in Magnetic Field?
questions.answer: T = 2 pi m/(q B)

questions.shortcut: Draw the model first, then apply the formula.
options: T = 2 pi m/(q B)
f = q B/(2 pi m)

questions.question: Which option correctly represents Cyclotron Frequency?

options: f = q B/(2 pi m)

questions.question: Which option correctly represents Force on Wire?
